newsitem.title: GERMANY: Bundesbank to keep rates on hold on Thursday - poll.
newsitem.headline: Bundesbank to keep rates on hold on Thursday - poll.

text.p: Following are the results of a poll of 10 economists on the expected outcome of this week's Bundesbank council meeting. The poll was conducted on Tuesday.
1. Will the Bundesbank cut its leading interest rates this
week?
Yes 0
No 10
2. Will there be a further cut in the discount and lombard
rates later this year?
Yes 0
No 10
3. Will there be another fixed tender at 3.00 this Thursday?
Yes 10
No 0
4. Do you expect the Bundesbank to abolish the minimum reserve requirement on repos?
Yes 1
No 9
Detailed results of the poll as follows:
Economist 1. 2. 3. 4.
Ralf Kugelstadt, UBS No. No. Yes. No.
Craig Shute, Bear Sterns No. No. Yes. No.
Ulrich Beckmann, Deutsche Bank No. No. Yes. Yes.
Nick Stamenkovich, DKB Intl No. No. Yes. No.
Ros Lifton, HSBC Markets No. No. Yes. No.
Thomas Kull, Westdt. Landesbank No. No. Yes. No.
Norbert Braems, BZW No. No. Yes. No.
Michael Schubert, Commerzbank No. No. Yes. No.
Sharda Persaud, San Paolo Bank No. No. Yes. No.
Howard Archer, Nat West Bank No. No. Yes. No.
